how: THE READING OF THE VERIFIED STATEMENTS, 2026-11-18. These lines stood under record physical-so-03, verified. The physical lane read every record of its own lane itself, so no sorter read this lane; main read all 1,390 of its verified statements one by one against their records' grounds.
